# Azure Reliability Platform — observed signals
Availability is sampled from **external monitor logs**, not a continuous SLA. Application request telemetry appears after Application Insights is provisioned and the instrumented image is deployed. Historical PostgreSQL check rows are independent evidence; workbook queries read Log Analytics, not PostgreSQL directly.

content.query: ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL | where TimeGenerated > ago(24h) and ContainerAppName_s == 'ca-arp-monitor-wus3' | where Log_s contains ' | healthy=' | extend healthy = extract(@'healthy=(True|False)', 1, Log_s) | where isnotempty(healthy) | summarize Checks=count(), Healthy=countif(healthy == 'True'), AvailabilityPercent=round(100.0 * countif(healthy == 'True') / count(),2)
content.title: Sampled availability

content.query: ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL | where TimeGenerated > ago(24h) and ContainerAppName_s == 'ca-arp-monitor-wus3' | where Log_s contains ' | latency=' | extend latency= todouble(extract(@'latency=([0-9.]+)ms',1,Log_s)) | where isnotnull(latency) | summarize AverageLatencyMs=avg(latency), P95LatencyMs=percentile(latency,95) by bin(TimeGenerated,5m) | order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: External checker latency by five minutes

items.name: External checker latency by five minutes

content.query: ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d) and ContainerAppName_s == 'ca-arp-monitor-wus3' | where Log_s has 'EVENT:' or Log_s has 'Restored state:' | project TimeGenerated, RevisionName_s, Log_s | order by TimeGenerated desc | take 100
content.title: Recent incident events and deployed monitor revision

items.name: Recent incident events and deployed monitor revision

content.query: AppRequests | where TimeGenerated > ago(24h) | summarize Requests=count(), Errors=countif(Success == false), MeanMs=avg(DurationMs), P95Ms=percentile(DurationMs,95) by bin(TimeGenerated,5m) | order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Application request volume, errors, and latency

items.name: Application request volume, errors, and latency

content.query: AppExceptions | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d) | project TimeGenerated, ProblemId, OuterMessage | order by TimeGenerated desc | take 50
content.title: Application exceptions

content.query: ContainerAppSystemLogs_CL | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d) and ContainerAppName_s == 'ca-arp-api-wus3' | project TimeGenerated, RevisionName_s, Log_s | order by TimeGenerated desc | take 100
content.title: Application revisions and deployment diagnostics
